title: Use trimmed QF_UF clause logs and search assumptions by shared symbols
summary: The clause-log exporter now uses trimmed QF_UF logs instead of falling back to the full log, and ties assumed clauses only to conjuncts that share an uninterpreted symbol with them. Lean checking is unchanged, while NEQ004_size4 needs about a third of the resolution steps and one large input exports in about a second instead of 90.
